nodes.label: FITD: Foot-In-The-Door Jailbreak
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Foot-In-The-Door- A Multi-turn Jailbreak for LLMs.pdf
nodes.author: Zixuan Weng; Xiaolong Jin; Jinyuan Jia; Xiangyu Zhang

nodes.label: Foot-in-the-Door Effect
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Foot-In-The-Door- A Multi-turn Jailbreak for LLMs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Psychological principle (Freedman & Fraser 1966; Cialdini 2001) that minor initial commitments lower resistance to larger transgressions; applied to erode LLM alignment over turns.

nodes.label: LLM Self-Corruption
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Foot-In-The-Door- A Multi-turn Jailbreak for LLMs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Using the model's own prior prompts/responses as stepping stones so it progressively lowers its own guard against toxic output.

nodes.label: SlipperySlopeParaphrase
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Foot-In-The-Door- A Multi-turn Jailbreak for LLMs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Inserts an intermediate bridging query between steps to create a smoother harmfulness progression when the model refuses.

nodes.label: Re-Align Module
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Foot-In-The-Door- A Multi-turn Jailbreak for LLMs.pdf
nodes.rationale: Re-queries the model to revise a misaligned/partially-refused response into a more aligned version, enforcing continued self-corruption.

nodes.label: Escalated Progression Sequence
nodes.source_file: Papers/Jailbreak/Foot-In-The-Door- A Multi-turn Jailbreak for LLMs.pdf
nodes.rationale: getProgressionSequence builds queries from a benign start to a fully harmful goal, sampled k=3 times per step for progressiveness and coherence.
